Luca: Quick postmortem follow-up from this morning's p95 spikes on /v1/generate. Thinking we need SLO edits + action owners. Summarizing here.

Maya: +1. I raised the postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/123 — main pattern: short bursts when cache misses + model fallback to larger variant.

Kevin: Can we get a dashboard tile for per-model p95 and fallback count? Current dashboard masks variants.

Anika: I'll take dashboard work (owner). ETA Tue 2026-04-02. Will add per-model p95 and fallback counter.

Luca: thanks. For SLOs, propose temp change: p95 latency 300ms -> 350ms for 2-week burn window while we stabilize. Anyone object?

Maya: fine as temporary mitigation; we should also add automatic fallback policy change to favor smaller model when async queue > X.

Kevin: action: update routing policy; I'll own model routing tweak. Target: 2026-03-31 EOD.

Anika: dashboard PR coming shortly. Example snippet: ```json
{ "panel": "model_p95", "group_by": "model_variant", "metrics": ["p95", "fallback_count"] }
```

sre-bot: Created issue #456: 'dashboard: per-model p95 + fallback counter' assigned to Anika.

ops-bot: Scheduled config change window 2026-03-31 22:00-23:00 UTC for routing tweak (low traffic).

Luca: Error budget: we burned ~0.6% of monthly budget in ~2h during the spike -> propose rebalancing and add alert at 0.5% burn rate over 24h.

Maya: I'll add the alerting rule and link it to the runbook; assigning to Maya. ETA Mon 2026-03-30.

Kevin: I'll do canary for routing change and watch p95; @Anika please ensure dashboard refresh frequency is 1m so we can see canary metrics.

Anika: will set refresh to 1m and add annotations for deploys; PR by EOD today.

Luca: Recurring incident pattern: similar bursts every 3-4 weeks correlated with batch jobs starting in the US evening window — ops to investigate batch scheduling and overlap with peak inference queues.

Maya: Filing follow-up task for batch job timing — assigning to ProductOps.

ProductOps: Acknowledged, will investigate batch windows and propose a reschedule or throttling strategy. ETA 2026-04-07.

Kevin: TL;DR action list: Anika (dashboard) by 2026-03-30, Kevin (routing) by 2026-03-31, Maya (alerts + runbook link) by 2026-03-30, ProductOps (batch investigation) by 2026-04-07. I'll run the canary and post results in this thread.

Luca: thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem and SLO change request doc and tag Legal/Support for any SLA customer comms. Closing loop next sync Wed.

Maya: :thumbsup:

sre-bot: postmortem doc updated: https://redwood.internal/pm/123#followups
